corpus_name: Stanford CUAD Legal Contract Understanding Benchmark

contracts.title: Enterprise Cloud Master Services Agreement (Section 9 - Liability & Governing Law)
contracts.content: Section 9.1 Cap on Liability: Except for breaches of confidentiality or IP indemnification obligations, neither party's aggregate cumulative liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall exceed the total fees paid by Customer to Provider in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to liability. Section 14.2 Governing Law: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of laws principles.

contracts.title: Enterprise Cloud Master Services Agreement (Section 11 - Non-Compete & Survival)
contracts.content: Section 11.4 Non-Compete Covenant: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination for cause, Contractor shall not directly develop or market a competing multi-tenant vector storage engine within North America or the EEA. Section 15.8 Survival: Sections 7 (Confidentiality), 9 (Limitation of Liability), and 11.4 (Non-Compete Covenant) shall survive any termination or expiration of this Agreement.

contracts.title: Enterprise Cloud Master Services Agreement (Section 12 - Anti-Assignment & Change of Control)
contracts.content: Section 12.1 Anti-Assignment: Neither party may assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld; provided, however, that either party may assign this Agreement in its entirety without consent to an Affiliate or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

contracts.title: Enterprise Cloud Master Services Agreement (Section 6 - Termination for Convenience)
contracts.content: Section 6.3 Termination for Convenience: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to Provider, provided Customer pays all undisputed fees accrued through the effective date of termination plus an early termination fee equal to 25% of remaining committed annual minimum spend.

contracts.title: Data Processing Addendum (GDPR & Standard Contractual Clauses)
contracts.content: Section 4.2 Cross-Border Transfers: Processor shall process EEA personal data solely in EU-central-2 unless Customer executes the 2021 EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2). Processor shall notify Customer within 48 hours of any confirmed Personal Data Breach.

contracts.title: Service Level Agreement (Uptime & Service Credits)
contracts.content: Section 2.1 Monthly Uptime Commitment: Provider guarantees 99.95% Monthly Uptime Percentage for Production APIs. If Monthly Uptime falls below 99.95%, Customer is eligible for a 10% Service Credit; below 99.0%, a 25% Service Credit applied to the next invoice.

contracts.title: Intellectual Property Ownership & Customer Data License
contracts.content: Section 8.1 Customer Content Ownership: Customer retains all right, title, and interest in Customer Data and Output. Provider retains all IP rights in the underlying Platform, Background IP, and aggregated anonymized telemetry.

contracts.title: Security Audit Rights & SOC 2 Type II Attestation
contracts.content: Section 10.3 Annual Security Audit: Once per twelve (12) months upon 30 days' written notice, Customer may review Provider's independent SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audit reports at no additional charge.

contracts.title: Force Majeure & Cloud Infrastructure Exclusion
contracts.content: Section 16.1 Force Majeure: Neither party shall be liable for delays caused by acts of God, war, or sovereign power grid failures; provided, however, that Force Majeure shall not excuse Customer's payment obligations for Services already rendered.

contracts.title: Source Code Escrow Release Triggers
contracts.content: Section 13.4 Source Code Escrow: Provider shall deposit source code and build scripts with Iron Mountain Escrow. Release triggers occur solely upon Provider's Chapter 7 bankruptcy filing or permanent cessation of support without an acquiring successor.

contracts.title: Most Favored Nation (MFN) Enterprise Pricing Clause
contracts.content: Section 5.5 Most Favored Nation: For annual commitments exceeding $1,000,000, Provider warrants that Customer's per-seat unit pricing is no less favorable than pricing offered to similarly situated commercial customers for comparable volume.

contracts.title: Auto-Renewal & Non-Renewal Notice Window
contracts.content: Section 6.1 Automatic Renewal: Each Order Form shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal at least forty-five (45) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

contracts.title: Subprocessor Approval & 30-Day Objection Right
contracts.content: Section 4.5 Subprocessors: Provider shall maintain an up-to-date subprocessor registry and provide 30 days' advance email notice before onboarding a new subprocessor. Customer may object on reasonable data-protection grounds within 15 days.

contracts.title: Open Source Software & Copyleft Warranty
contracts.content: Section 7.4 Copyleft Exclusion: Provider warrants that the deliverables do not incorporate any viral copyleft open-source software (such as GPLv3 or AGPLv3) in a manner that would require Customer to disclose its proprietary source code.

contracts.title: Export Control & EAR/OFAC Sanctions Compliance
contracts.content: Section 17.2 Export Compliance: Customer shall not export or re-export the Software in violation of U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) or OFAC sanctions lists, and represents it is not located in an embargoed jurisdiction.

contracts.title: Commercial General & Cyber Liability Insurance Minimums
contracts.content: Section 18.1 Required Insurance: Provider shall maintain Cyber & Tech Errors and Omissions insurance with minimum coverage of $5,000,000 per occurrence and Commercial General Liability of $2,000,000 per occurrence.

contracts.title: Binding Arbitration & JAMS Venue Selection
contracts.content: Section 14.5 Arbitration: Any dispute exceeding $100,000 not resolved by executive escalation within 30 days shall be settled by binding arbitration administered by JAMS in Wilmington, Delaware before a single neutral arbitrator.

contracts.title: Publicity, Logo Usage & Press Release Consent
contracts.content: Section 19.3 Publicity Restrictions: Provider may not issue any press release or use Customer's trademarks, logos, or trade names in marketing materials without Customer's prior express written approval.

contracts.title: Post-Termination Data Export & Cryptographic Deletion
contracts.content: Section 6.6 Data Return & Purge: Upon termination, Provider shall make Customer Data available for export in JSON/Parquet format for 30 days, and thereafter cryptographically erase all copies within 14 days.

contracts.title: Benchmarking & Competitive Performance Testing Ban
contracts.content: Section 3.4 Benchmark Prohibition: Customer shall not publish comparative latency or throughput benchmarks of the Platform against competing products without Provider's prior written consent.

contracts.title: Renewal Price Escalation Cap (CPI / 5% Ceiling)
contracts.content: Section 5.3 Renewal Price Cap: Upon any automatic renewal term, Provider may increase recurring subscription fees by no more than the lesser of 5% or the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U) for the prior year.

contracts.title: AI Model Training Opt-Out & Zero Data Retention
contracts.content: Section 8.4 Zero AI Training Guarantee: Provider shall not use Customer Prompts, embeddings, or fine-tuning datasets to train or improve foundation models shared with third parties, enforcing zero-day prompt retention.

eval_dataset.query: What is the aggregate liability cap and which state's law governs the agreement?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Aggregate liability is capped at total fees paid in the 12 months preceding the event, excluding confidentiality or IP indemnification. The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

eval_dataset.query: How long does the non-compete covenant last after termination and does it survive contract termination?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: The non-compete lasts for 24 months following expiration or termination for cause and explicitly survives termination under Section 15.8.

eval_dataset.query: Can a party assign the agreement during a merger or acquisition without prior written consent?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Yes, either party may assign the Agreement in its entirety without prior written consent in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets.

eval_dataset.query: What notice period and early termination fee apply if the customer terminates for convenience?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Customer must provide 60 days prior written notice and pay an early termination fee equal to 25% of remaining committed annual minimum spend.

eval_dataset.query: Within how many hours must Processor notify Customer of a Personal Data Breach under the DPA?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Processor must notify Customer within 48 hours of any confirmed Personal Data Breach.

eval_dataset.query: What is the Monthly Uptime Commitment and what Service Credit applies below 99.0%?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Monthly Uptime Commitment is 99.95%, with a 25% Service Credit if uptime falls below 99.0%.

eval_dataset.query: Who owns Customer Data and Output versus the underlying Platform Background IP?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Customer retains all rights to Customer Data and Output; Provider retains IP in the Platform and Background IP.

eval_dataset.query: What security audit reports can Customer review annually and with how much notice?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Customer may review SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reports once per 12 months upon 30 days' written notice.

eval_dataset.query: Does Force Majeure excuse Customer's payment obligations for Services already rendered?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: No, Force Majeure does not excuse Customer's payment obligations for Services already rendered.

eval_dataset.query: Who is the escrow agent and what triggers source code escrow release?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Iron Mountain Escrow holds the source code, released upon Chapter 7 bankruptcy or permanent cessation of support.

eval_dataset.query: What minimum annual commitment qualifies for the Most Favored Nation pricing clause?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Annual commitments exceeding $1,000,000 qualify for Most Favored Nation unit pricing.

eval_dataset.query: How many days' advance notice is required to prevent automatic 12-month renewal?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Written notice of non-renewal must be delivered at least 45 days prior to the end of the current term.

eval_dataset.query: How much advance notice must Provider give before onboarding a new subprocessor?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Provider must give 30 days' advance email notice and Customer has 15 days to object.

eval_dataset.query: Which copyleft open-source licenses are excluded by Provider's warranty?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Viral copyleft licenses such as GPLv3 and AGPLv3 are excluded.

eval_dataset.query: What minimum Cyber & Tech Errors and Omissions insurance coverage must Provider maintain?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Provider must maintain $5,000,000 per occurrence in Cyber & Tech E&O insurance.

eval_dataset.query: Which arbitration organization and city govern disputes exceeding $100,000?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Binding arbitration is administered by JAMS in Wilmington, Delaware.

eval_dataset.query: How long is Customer Data available for export after termination and in what formats?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Customer Data is available in JSON/Parquet format for 30 days, then cryptographically erased within 14 days.

eval_dataset.query: What is the maximum annual fee increase allowed on automatic renewal?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: Fee increases are capped at the lesser of 5% or CPI-U for the prior year.

eval_dataset.query: Can Provider use Customer Prompts or embeddings to train shared foundation models?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: No, Provider enforces zero-day prompt retention and cannot use Customer Prompts or embeddings to train third-party models.

eval_dataset.query: May Provider use Customer's trademarks or logos in marketing without written approval?
eval_dataset.ground_truth: No, Provider may not use Customer's trademarks or logos without prior express written approval.
